text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Algeria is a free and independent state. Algeria is not any foreign state's province. The newspaper was referring to France which was criticised on Friday by Algeria's foreign minister Ahmed Attaf over French leaders' comments on Algeria's civil strife.
- Workers' Union Generale des Travailleurs Algeriens (UGTA) to stage a nationwide stoppage on Saturday to mourn its slain leader Abdelhak Benhamouda.
- Former general Habib Khelil was killed in Oran: A first gunman shot him in the head then a second gunmen shot him twice as the former general was collapsing.
- FIDA Moslem fundamentalist armed group claims responsibility for killing Benhamouda.
- Algerian pro-democracy activists vow to continue the political path followed by Benhamouda to build a modern and republican Algeria.
- Several weapons purchasing networks to supply armed groups in Algeria have been dismantled in Europe after a strong reaction from Algeria and Germany.
